CREATE TABLE payment_intents (
            reference TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,auth_version INTEGER NOT NULL,membership_id INTEGER NOT NULL,authority_version INTEGER NOT NULL,application_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            provider TEXT NOT NULL,amount_tzs INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_tzs)='integer' AND amount_tzs BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000),currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='TZS'),
            idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 80),order_reference TEXT,
            status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','unknown','confirmed','failed')),dispatch_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(dispatch_state IN ('unattempted','attempted')),
            provider_reference TEXT,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>=1),last_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(last_sequence>=0),
            UNIQUE(merchant_id,provider,idempotency_key),UNIQUE(provider,provider_reference))

CREATE TABLE payment_events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,provider TEXT NOT NULL,provider_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,payment_reference TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payment_intents(reference),body_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
            raw_body TEXT CHECK(raw_body IS NULL OR length(CAST(raw_body AS BLOB))<=4096),received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,retain_until INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(retain_until>received_at),
            normalized_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(normalized_status IN ('pending','unknown','confirmed','failed')),sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence>0),outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('applied','duplicate_outcome','out_of_order','conflict')),occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(occurred_at>=0),
            UNIQUE(provider,provider_event_id))

CREATE TABLE payment_confirmations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,payment_reference TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES payment_intents(reference),event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES payment_events(id),merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            amount_tzs INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_tzs)='integer' AND amount_tzs>0),currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='TZS'),confirmed_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TRIGGER payment_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON payment_intents WHEN NEW.reference IS NOT OLD.reference OR NEW.merchant_id IS NOT OLD.merchant_id OR NEW.actor_id IS NOT OLD.actor_id
            OR NEW.auth_version IS NOT OLD.auth_version OR NEW.membership_id IS NOT OLD.membership_id OR NEW.authority_version IS NOT OLD.authority_version OR NEW.application_id IS NOT OLD.application_id
            OR NEW.provider IS NOT OLD.provider OR NEW.amount_tzs IS NOT OLD.amount_tzs OR NEW.currency IS NOT OLD.currency OR NEW.idempotency_key IS NOT OLD.idempotency_key OR NEW.order_reference IS NOT OLD.order_reference
            OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at OR NEW.updated_at<OLD.updated_at OR NEW.version!=OLD.version+1 OR NEW.last_sequence<OLD.last_sequence OR (OLD.provider_reference IS NOT NULL AND NEW.provider_reference IS NOT OLD.provider_reference)
            OR (OLD.status IN ('confirmed','failed') AND NEW.status!=OLD.status) OR (OLD.dispatch_state='attempted' AND NEW.dispatch_state!='attempted') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Payment invariant denied'); END
CREATE TRIGGER payment_intents_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payment_intents BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Payment history is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER payment_intents_replace BEFORE INSERT ON payment_intents WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_intents WHERE reference=NEW.reference) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Payment replacement denied'); END
CREATE TRIGGER payment_events_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payment_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Payment history is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER payment_events_replace BEFORE INSERT ON payment_events WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_events WHERE id=NEW.id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Payment replacement denied'); END
CREATE TRIGGER payment_confirmations_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payment_confirmations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Payment history is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER payment_confirmations_replace BEFORE INSERT ON payment_confirmations WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_confirmations WHERE id=NEW.id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Payment replacement denied'); END
CREATE TRIGGER payment_confirmations_update BEFORE UPDATE ON payment_confirmations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Payment evidence is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER payment_events_update BEFORE UPDATE ON payment_events WHEN NOT(OLD.raw_body IS NOT NULL AND NEW.raw_body IS NULL AND NEW.id IS OLD.id AND NEW.provider IS OLD.provider AND NEW.provider_event_id IS OLD.provider_event_id
            AND NEW.payment_reference IS OLD.payment_reference AND NEW.body_hash IS OLD.body_hash AND NEW.received_at IS OLD.received_at AND NEW.retain_until IS OLD.retain_until AND NEW.normalized_status IS OLD.normalized_status AND NEW.sequence IS OLD.sequence AND NEW.outcome IS OLD.outcome AND NEW.occurred_at IS OLD.occurred_at) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Payment evidence is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE ledger_accounts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,account_type TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='TZS'),created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_at)='integer' AND created_at>=0),
                CHECK((kind='simulated_clearing_receivable' AND account_type='asset') OR (kind='merchant_pending_obligation' AND account_type='liability')),
                UNIQUE(merchant_id,kind,currency),UNIQUE(id,merchant_id,currency,kind))

CREATE TABLE ledger_journals(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,consumer TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(consumer='mock-payment-accounting-v1'),confirmation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payment_confirmations(id),payment_reference TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payment_intents(reference),merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                amount_tzs INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_tzs)='integer' AND amount_tzs BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000),currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='TZS'),source_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(source_hash)=64 AND source_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),posted_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(posted_at)='integer' AND posted_at BETWEEN 0 AND 253402214399999),
                UNIQUE(consumer,confirmation_id),UNIQUE(payment_reference),UNIQUE(id,merchant_id,currency),
                FOREIGN KEY(id) REFERENCES ledger_seals(journal_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE ledger_postings(journal_id TEXT NOT NULL,line INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(line IN (1,2)),account_id TEXT NOT NULL,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='TZS'),kind TEXT NOT NULL,direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(direction IN ('debit','credit')),amount_tzs INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_tzs)='integer' AND amount_tzs BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000),
                CHECK((line=1 AND direction='debit' AND kind='simulated_clearing_receivable') OR (line=2 AND direction='credit' AND kind='merchant_pending_obligation')),
                PRIMARY KEY(journal_id,line),UNIQUE(journal_id,direction),
                FOREIGN KEY(journal_id,merchant_id,currency) REFERENCES ledger_journals(id,merchant_id,currency),
                FOREIGN KEY(account_id,merchant_id,currency,kind) REFERENCES ledger_accounts(id,merchant_id,currency,kind))
CREATE TABLE ledger_seals(journal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_journals(id))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_source BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_journals WHEN NOT EXISTS(
                SELECT 1 FROM payment_confirmations c JOIN payment_intents p ON p.reference=c.payment_reference JOIN payment_events e ON e.id=c.event_id
                WHERE c.id=NEW.confirmation_id AND c.payment_reference=NEW.payment_reference AND c.merchant_id=NEW.merchant_id AND c.amount_tzs=NEW.amount_tzs AND c.currency=NEW.currency
                AND c.confirmed_at<=NEW.posted_at AND c.confirmed_at=e.received_at AND p.merchant_id=c.merchant_id AND p.amount_tzs=c.amount_tzs AND p.currency=c.currency
                AND p.provider='fictional_mock' AND p.dispatch_state='attempted' AND p.status='confirmed' AND e.provider=p.provider AND e.payment_reference=p.reference
                AND e.outcome='applied' AND e.normalized_status='confirmed' AND e.sequence<=p.last_sequence AND e.occurred_at>=p.created_at)
                BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Authoritative fictional confirmation required'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_posting_open BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_postings WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_seals WHERE journal_id=NEW.journal_id)
                BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Posted journal is sealed'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_balanced BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_seals WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_journals j WHERE j.id=NEW.journal_id
                AND (SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_postings WHERE journal_id=j.id)=2
                AND (SELECT sum(amount_tzs) FROM ledger_postings WHERE journal_id=j.id AND direction='debit')=j.amount_tzs
                AND (SELECT sum(amount_tzs) FROM ledger_postings WHERE journal_id=j.id AND direction='credit')=j.amount_tzs)
                BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Complete balanced journal required'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_accounts_update BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_accounts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Ledger history is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_accounts_delete BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_accounts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Ledger history is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_accounts_replace BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_accounts WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_accounts WHERE id=NEW.id OR (merchant_id=NEW.merchant_id AND kind=NEW.kind AND currency=NEW.currency)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Ledger replacement denied'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_journals_update BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_journals BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Ledger history is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_journals_delete BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_journals BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Ledger history is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_journals_replace BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_journals WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_journals WHERE id=NEW.id OR confirmation_id=NEW.confirmation_id OR payment_reference=NEW.payment_reference) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Ledger replacement denied'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_update BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Ledger history is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_delete BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Ledger history is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_replace BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_postings WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_postings WHERE journal_id=NEW.journal_id AND (line=NEW.line OR direction=NEW.direction)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Ledger replacement denied'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_seals_update BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_seals BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Ledger history is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_seals_delete BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_seals BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Ledger history is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_seals_replace BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_seals WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_seals WHERE journal_id=NEW.journal_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Ledger replacement denied'); END

CREATE TABLE payment_links(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,public_token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(public_token)=64 AND public_token NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,auth_version INTEGER NOT NULL,membership_id INTEGER NOT NULL,authority_version INTEGER NOT NULL,application_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            amount_tzs INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_tzs)='integer' AND amount_tzs BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000),currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='TZS'),description TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(description) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND instr(description,char(0))=0),business_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            request_key TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('active','disabled')),created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_at)='integer' AND created_at>=0),expires_at INTEGER CHECK(expires_at IS NULL OR (typeof(expires_at)='integer' AND expires_at>created_at)),disabled_at INTEGER,
            CHECK((state='active' AND disabled_at IS NULL) OR (state='disabled' AND typeof(disabled_at)='integer' AND disabled_at>=created_at)),UNIQUE(merchant_id,request_key))

CREATE TABLE checkout_attempts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,link_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payment_links(id),customer_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(customer_hash)=64),nonce_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(nonce_hash)=64),created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_at)='integer' AND created_at>=0),payment_reference TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES payment_intents(reference),UNIQUE(link_id,customer_hash))

CREATE TRIGGER link_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON payment_links WHEN NOT(OLD.state='active' AND NEW.state='disabled' AND NEW.disabled_at>=OLD.created_at
            AND NEW.id IS OLD.id AND NEW.public_token IS OLD.public_token AND NEW.merchant_id IS OLD.merchant_id AND NEW.actor_id IS OLD.actor_id AND NEW.auth_version IS OLD.auth_version AND NEW.membership_id IS OLD.membership_id AND NEW.authority_version IS OLD.authority_version AND NEW.application_id IS OLD.application_id
            AND NEW.amount_tzs IS OLD.amount_tzs AND NEW.currency IS OLD.currency AND NEW.description IS OLD.description AND NEW.business_name IS OLD.business_name AND NEW.request_key IS OLD.request_key AND NEW.created_at IS OLD.created_at AND NEW.expires_at IS OLD.expires_at)
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Link identity is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER attempt_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON checkout_attempts WHEN NOT(OLD.payment_reference IS NULL AND NEW.payment_reference IS NOT NULL AND NEW.id IS OLD.id AND NEW.link_id IS OLD.link_id AND NEW.customer_hash IS OLD.customer_hash AND NEW.nonce_hash IS OLD.nonce_hash AND NEW.created_at IS OLD.created_at
            AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_links l JOIN payment_intents p ON p.reference=NEW.payment_reference WHERE l.id=NEW.link_id AND p.merchant_id=l.merchant_id AND p.actor_id=l.actor_id AND p.auth_version=l.auth_version AND p.membership_id=l.membership_id AND p.authority_version=l.authority_version AND p.application_id=l.application_id
            AND p.amount_tzs=l.amount_tzs AND p.currency=l.currency AND p.idempotency_key='checkout_'||NEW.id AND p.order_reference=NEW.id))
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Checkout association is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER payment_links_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payment_links BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Link history is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER payment_links_replace BEFORE INSERT ON payment_links WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_links WHERE id=NEW.id OR public_token=NEW.public_token OR (merchant_id=NEW.merchant_id AND request_key=NEW.request_key)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Link replacement denied'); END
CREATE TRIGGER checkout_attempts_delete BEFORE DELETE ON checkout_attempts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Link history is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER checkout_attempts_replace BEFORE INSERT ON checkout_attempts WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkout_attempts WHERE id=NEW.id OR nonce_hash=NEW.nonce_hash OR (link_id=NEW.link_id AND customer_hash=NEW.customer_hash)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Link replacement denied'); END
CREATE TRIGGER attempt_initial BEFORE INSERT ON checkout_attempts WHEN NEW.payment_reference IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Checkout must reserve before payment creation'); END

p8: CREATE TABLE funds_withdrawals(reference TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,request_key TEXT NOT NULL,destination_reference TEXT NOT NULL,destination_mask TEXT NOT NULL,amount_tzs INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_tzs)='integer' AND amount_tzs BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000),created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(merchant_id,request_key),FOREIGN KEY(reference) REFERENCES ledger_lifecycle_journals(withdrawal_reference) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE ledger_lifecycle_journals(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('settlement','reserve','release','payout')),amount_tzs INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_tzs)='integer' AND amount_tzs BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000),source_journal TEXT REFERENCES ledger_seals(journal_id),withdrawal_reference TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES funds_withdrawals(reference),related_withdrawal TEXT REFERENCES funds_withdrawals(reference),evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,body TEXT NOT NULL,signature TEXT NOT NULL,posted_at INTEGER NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(id) REFERENCES ledger_lifecycle_seals(journal_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,CHECK((kind='settlement' AND source_journal IS NOT NULL AND withdrawal_reference IS NULL AND related_withdrawal IS NULL) OR (kind='reserve' AND source_journal IS NULL AND withdrawal_reference IS NOT NULL AND related_withdrawal IS NULL) OR (kind IN ('release','payout') AND source_journal IS NULL AND withdrawal_reference IS NULL AND related_withdrawal IS NOT NULL)),UNIQUE(source_journal),UNIQUE(related_withdrawal))

CREATE TABLE ledger_lifecycle_postings(journal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_lifecycle_journals(id),line INTEGER NOT NULL,account TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(account IN ('simulated_settled_cash','simulated_clearing_receivable','merchant_pending_obligation','merchant_available_obligation','merchant_reserved_obligation')),direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(direction IN ('debit','credit')),amount_tzs INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_tzs)='integer' AND amount_tzs>0),PRIMARY KEY(journal_id,line))
CREATE TABLE ledger_lifecycle_seals(journal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_lifecycle_journals(id))
CREATE TABLE funds_dispatches(withdrawal_reference TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES funds_withdrawals(reference),attempted_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE funds_events(event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,withdrawal_reference TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES funds_withdrawals(reference),merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','confirmed','failed','unresolved')),body TEXT NOT NULL,signature TEXT NOT NULL,body_hash TEXT NOT NULL,received_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX funds_events_withdrawal ON funds_events(withdrawal_reference,received_at,event_id)
CREATE INDEX lifecycle_merchant ON ledger_lifecycle_journals(merchant_id,kind)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lifecycle_settlement_transaction ON ledger_lifecycle_journals(json_extract(body,'$.provider_transaction')) WHERE kind='settlement'

CREATE TRIGGER lifecycle_no_overdraw BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_lifecycle_journals WHEN NEW.kind='reserve' AND NEW.amount_tzs>(SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN kind IN ('settlement','release') THEN amount_tzs WHEN kind='reserve' THEN -amount_tzs ELSE 0 END),0) FROM ledger_lifecycle_journals WHERE merchant_id=NEW.merchant_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Insufficient simulated funds'); END

CREATE TRIGGER lifecycle_source BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_lifecycle_journals WHEN (NEW.kind='settlement' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_journals j JOIN ledger_seals s ON s.journal_id=j.id WHERE j.id=NEW.source_journal AND j.merchant_id=NEW.merchant_id AND j.amount_tzs=NEW.amount_tzs AND j.posted_at<=NEW.posted_at)) OR (NEW.kind<>'settlement' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM funds_withdrawals w WHERE w.reference=coalesce(NEW.withdrawal_reference,NEW.related_withdrawal) AND w.merchant_id=NEW.merchant_id AND w.amount_tzs=NEW.amount_tzs AND w.created_at<=NEW.posted_at)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Lifecycle source mismatch'); END

CREATE TRIGGER lifecycle_posting_shape BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_lifecycle_postings WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_lifecycle_journals j WHERE j.id=NEW.journal_id AND j.amount_tzs=NEW.amount_tzs AND ((j.kind='settlement' AND ((NEW.line=1 AND NEW.account='simulated_settled_cash' AND NEW.direction='debit') OR (NEW.line=2 AND NEW.account='simulated_clearing_receivable' AND NEW.direction='credit') OR (NEW.line=3 AND NEW.account='merchant_pending_obligation' AND NEW.direction='debit') OR (NEW.line=4 AND NEW.account='merchant_available_obligation' AND NEW.direction='credit'))) OR (j.kind='reserve' AND ((NEW.line=1 AND NEW.account='merchant_available_obligation' AND NEW.direction='debit') OR (NEW.line=2 AND NEW.account='merchant_reserved_obligation' AND NEW.direction='credit'))) OR (j.kind='release' AND ((NEW.line=1 AND NEW.account='merchant_reserved_obligation' AND NEW.direction='debit') OR (NEW.line=2 AND NEW.account='merchant_available_obligation' AND NEW.direction='credit'))) OR (j.kind='payout' AND ((NEW.line=1 AND NEW.account='merchant_reserved_obligation' AND NEW.direction='debit') OR (NEW.line=2 AND NEW.account='simulated_settled_cash' AND NEW.direction='credit'))))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Lifecycle posting mismatch'); END

CREATE TRIGGER lifecycle_posting_open BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_lifecycle_postings WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_lifecycle_seals WHERE journal_id=NEW.journal_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Journal sealed'); END

CREATE TRIGGER lifecycle_balanced BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_lifecycle_seals WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_lifecycle_journals j WHERE j.id=NEW.journal_id AND (SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_lifecycle_postings WHERE journal_id=j.id)=CASE WHEN j.kind='settlement' THEN 4 ELSE 2 END AND (SELECT sum(amount_tzs) FROM ledger_lifecycle_postings WHERE journal_id=j.id AND direction='debit')=j.amount_tzs*CASE WHEN j.kind='settlement' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AND (SELECT sum(amount_tzs) FROM ledger_lifecycle_postings WHERE journal_id=j.id AND direction='credit')=j.amount_tzs*CASE WHEN j.kind='settlement' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Balanced lifecycle journal required'); END
CREATE TRIGGER funds_withdrawals_update BEFORE UPDATE ON funds_withdrawals BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds history immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER funds_withdrawals_delete BEFORE DELETE ON funds_withdrawals BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds history immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER funds_withdrawals_replace BEFORE INSERT ON funds_withdrawals WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM funds_withdrawals WHERE reference=NEW.reference OR (merchant_id=NEW.merchant_id AND request_key=NEW.request_key)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds replacement denied'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_lifecycle_journals_update BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_lifecycle_journals BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds history immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_lifecycle_journals_delete BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_lifecycle_journals BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds history immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_lifecycle_journals_replace BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_lifecycle_journals WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_lifecycle_journals WHERE id=NEW.id OR event_id=NEW.event_id OR (source_journal IS NOT NULL AND source_journal=NEW.source_journal) OR (related_withdrawal IS NOT NULL AND related_withdrawal=NEW.related_withdrawal)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds replacement denied'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_lifecycle_postings_update BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_lifecycle_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds history immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_lifecycle_postings_delete BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_lifecycle_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds history immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_lifecycle_postings_replace BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_lifecycle_postings WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_lifecycle_postings WHERE journal_id=NEW.journal_id AND line=NEW.line) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds replacement denied'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_lifecycle_seals_update BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_lifecycle_seals BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds history immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_lifecycle_seals_delete BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_lifecycle_seals BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds history immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_lifecycle_seals_replace BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_lifecycle_seals WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_lifecycle_seals WHERE journal_id=NEW.journal_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds replacement denied'); END
CREATE TRIGGER funds_dispatches_update BEFORE UPDATE ON funds_dispatches BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds history immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER funds_dispatches_delete BEFORE DELETE ON funds_dispatches BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds history immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER funds_dispatches_replace BEFORE INSERT ON funds_dispatches WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM funds_dispatches WHERE withdrawal_reference=NEW.withdrawal_reference) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds replacement denied'); END
CREATE TRIGGER funds_events_update BEFORE UPDATE ON funds_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds history immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER funds_events_delete BEFORE DELETE ON funds_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds history immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER funds_events_replace BEFORE INSERT ON funds_events WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM funds_events WHERE event_id=NEW.event_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Funds replacement denied'); END
p9: CREATE TABLE api_credentials(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,authority TEXT NOT NULL,token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,scopes TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,last_four TEXT NOT NULL,rotated_from TEXT REFERENCES api_credentials(id),revoked_at INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE api_rate_windows(credential_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES api_credentials(id),window INTEGER NOT NULL,count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(count BETWEEN 1 AND 120))

CREATE TRIGGER credential_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON api_credentials WHEN NOT(OLD.revoked_at IS NULL AND NEW.revoked_at>=OLD.created_at AND NEW.id IS OLD.id AND NEW.merchant_id IS OLD.merchant_id AND NEW.authority IS OLD.authority AND NEW.token_hash IS OLD.token_hash AND NEW.scopes IS OLD.scopes AND NEW.created_at IS OLD.created_at AND NEW.expires_at IS OLD.expires_at AND NEW.last_four IS OLD.last_four AND NEW.rotated_from IS OLD.rotated_from) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Credential identity is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE checkout_widgets(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,link_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payment_links(id),kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('qr','button')),mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('dynamic','reusable')),UNIQUE(link_id,kind,mode))

CREATE TABLE merchant_webhook_endpoints(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,url TEXT NOT NULL,encrypted_secret TEXT NOT NULL,enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)),created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE merchant_webhook_events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,confirmation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,body TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE merchant_webhook_deliveries(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES merchant_webhook_events(id),endpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES merchant_webhook_endpoints(id),status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','sending','retry','delivered','exhausted','disabled')),attempts INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 3),next_at INTEGER NOT NULL,http_status INTEGER,claim TEXT,UNIQUE(event_id,endpoint_id))

CREATE TABLE merchant_webhook_attempts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,delivery_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES merchant_webhook_deliveries(id),number INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,http_status INTEGER,UNIQUE(delivery_id,number))
CREATE TABLE merchant_webhook_receipts(event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,body_hash TEXT NOT NULL,received_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TRIGGER widget_merchant BEFORE INSERT ON checkout_widgets WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_links WHERE id=NEW.link_id AND merchant_id=NEW.merchant_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Widget merchant mismatch'); END

CREATE TRIGGER webhook_event_source BEFORE INSERT ON merchant_webhook_events WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_confirmations WHERE id=NEW.confirmation_id AND merchant_id=NEW.merchant_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Webhook source mismatch'); END

CREATE TRIGGER webhook_delivery_tenant BEFORE INSERT ON merchant_webhook_deliveries WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM merchant_webhook_events v JOIN merchant_webhook_endpoints e ON e.id=NEW.endpoint_id WHERE v.id=NEW.event_id AND v.merchant_id=NEW.merchant_id AND e.merchant_id=NEW.merchant_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Webhook tenant mismatch'); END
CREATE TRIGGER checkout_widgets_update BEFORE UPDATE ON checkout_widgets BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'P9 immutable history'); END
CREATE TRIGGER merchant_webhook_events_update BEFORE UPDATE ON merchant_webhook_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'P9 immutable history'); END
CREATE TRIGGER merchant_webhook_receipts_update BEFORE UPDATE ON merchant_webhook_receipts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'P9 immutable history'); END
